title: Igloo agents
description: A repository's trust settings and coding tools, read from .igloo/agents.toml on its default branch.

protected.description: Glob patterns of repository-relative paths whose changes merge only after a human approves them. `*` stays within one directory; `**` crosses directories.

default_tool.description: The tool tasks use unless they name another; one of tools.

install.description: Shell command installing the tool over the warm snapshot; runs once per agent snapshot, with network access.

command.description: For the command harness: the command to run, with the task's goal as its last argument.

secrets.description: Repository secrets the tool gets as environment variables, such as its credential.

timeout_seconds.description: How long one turn may run.

max_turns.description: How many turns a task may take.
